            return False
        for pl in cands[i]:

            curr.append(pl)
            if bt(i+1,used|set(map(tuple,pl))): return True
            curr.pop()
        return False
    ok=bt(0,set())

    return objs,sols

def analyze(n):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in gi for c in r); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs={}
    seen=set()
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j]==bgc or (i,j) in seen: continue
            stack=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop()
                if (a,b) in seen or gi[a][b]!=gi[i][j]: continue
                seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                col=gi[a][b]
                for di in(-1,0,1):
                    for dj in(-1,0,1):
                        x,y=a+di,b+dj
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and (x,y) not in seen and gi[x][y]==col:
                            stack.append((x,y))
            k=sorted(set(gi[p] for p in comp))
            objs.setdefault(k,[]).append(sorted(comp))
    return gi,go,bgc,objs

for n in [1,2,3]:
    gi,go,bgc,objs=analyze(n)
    print(f'=== demo{n} bg={bgc}')
    for cols,comps in objs.items():
        for comp in comps:
            rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            R=(max(rs)-min(rs))+1; C=(max(cs)-min(cs))+1
            allcorn=all(gi[min(rs)][min(cs)]==cols[0] and gi[min(rs)][max(cs)]==cols[0]
                        and gi[max(rs)][min(cs)]==cols[0] and gi[max(rs)][max(cs)]==cols[0] for _ in [0])
            rel=tuple(sorted((p[0]-min(rs),p[1]-min(cs)) for p in comp))
            mark='MARKER(rect corners)' if len(set(cols))==1 and allcorn else 'obj'
            print(f'  color{cols}: size {R}x{C}, at ({min(rs)},{min(cs)}), {rel}')
    # outputs diff
    print('OUTPUT vs INPUT cells changed:')
    diff=[(i,j,gi[i][j],go[i][j]) for i in range(len(go)) for j in range(len(go[0])) if gi[i][j]!=go[i][j]]
    print(diff[:40])
